mechanism: Lisdexamfetamine increases sympathomimetic activity and heart rate while quinidine prolongs QT interval and has negative inotropic effects, creating additive cardiac risk; quinidine inhibits CYP2D6 which metabolizes amphetamines, increasing amphetamine levels.
action: Avoid concurrent use if possible; if necessary, monitor cardiac function closely with ECG and reduce lisdexamfetamine dose; monitor for signs of amphetamine toxicity.
